disposition_reason: The opinion's batch-to-batch table prints mercury, cadmium, arsenic, lead and other metals for five batches of the DHA-rich algal oil intended for infant and follow-on formula; all toxic-metal results are below LOQ except where noted. The Panel concluded the NF is safe under the proposed conditions of use.

study.design: EFSA NDA Panel novel-food safety opinion; applicant batch-to-batch compositional data (5 batches)
study.origin: Applicant's commercial fermentation of Schizochytrium sp. strain CABIO-A-2; production site not stated
study.method: Lead, arsenic, cadmium by BS EN ISO 17294-2:2016 mod. (ICP-MS); mercury by BS EN 13806:2002; copper DIN EN ISO 17294-2 or AOCS Ca 17-01; iron AOCS Ca 17-01 or ICP-MS (Table 1)
study.lod_text: LOQs printed in the table cells: Pb 0.05 mg/kg; tAs 0.05 mg/kg; tHg 0.005 mg/kg; Cd 0.01 mg/kg; Cu 0.01/0.05 mg/kg; Fe 0.02/0.1 mg/kg
study.qa: Panel states the applicant provided information on the accreditation of the laboratories; no CRM or recovery data reported in the opinion

findings.notes: Below LOQ; limit given in lod_ugkg is the printed LOQ (a: LOQ). Five batches of the NF (footnote b in Table 1 marks batches that did not undergo winterisation).
